input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the served air volume of the Lab, from the occupant-CO2 rise and scrubber-driven decay.
hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone during the test.
The closed /habitat/lab/hatch-1-v6 remains in one position throughout; exchange through it is not measured and is small enough not to dominate the fitted Lab decay.
The three Lab occupants remain in the Lab at steady activity throughout, so their combined CO2 source is approximately steady.
The scrubber's registered effective flow at each accepted speed is valid during the test.
Fit the full-speed record to C(t) = C_eq + (C_0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau), then calculate V_lab = Qe * tau; do not fit toward zero or outdoor concentration.

monitoring.reason: The test intentionally raises CO2 in the occupied Lab; stop for an out-of-band vital sign, lost monitoring, or changed occupancy.

steps.why: Hold the Lab as one zone and reduce effective cleaning so occupant CO2 rises several hundred ppm above sensor noise; record Lab and Hab-B CO2, accepted speed, and occupancy at one-minute intervals.
Keep the same zone boundary, return to full speed, and record the approach to the nonzero equilibrium at one-minute intervals for the exponential fit.

abort.when: Lab CO2 is at or above 3200 ppm.
The scrubber refuses either commanded speed.
Battery state of charge is under 35 percent.
Any monitored subject is outside 45–120 bpm, monitoring is lost, or one more person is present in the Lab.

expected.start: Lab CO2 begins near the measured 1800 ppm while the hatch is closed and the same three occupants remain at steady activity.
expected.rise: At 30 percent speed, Lab CO2 should rise by several hundred ppm while remaining below 3000 ppm; failure to rise above sensor noise indicates inadequate excitation or a non-steady source.
expected.decay: At 100 percent speed, Lab CO2 should fall exponentially toward a fitted nonzero C_eq. A poor exponential fit, discontinuity, or changing occupant count invalidates the single-zone/steady-source hypotheses.
expected.connectedZone: Hab-B CO2 should not track the Lab transient strongly. Correlated movement indicates material exchange through the closed hatch and rejects the negligible-exchange hypothesis.
expected.result: From the accepted full-speed effective flow Qe and fitted tau, report V_lab = Qe * tau in m3, with fit residuals and uncertainty; do not report V_lab if an abort occurs or a hypothesis is rejected.

justifications.reason: Lowest speed allowed by signed rule.
Half of bounded test for observable rise.
Remaining bounded time for decay fit.
Signed minimum battery state of charge.
